strings.(한적한 아발론의 골목, 렌이 모래안개에 가려져 보이지 않는 대상을 향해: (In a quiet alley of Avalon, Ren warily watches a figure obscured by drifting sand.)
Oh, Adventurer. I sensed a powerful presence and went on guard for a moment.
strings.그러셨구나. 정찰 중이었어요?: I see. Are you on patrol?
strings.네, 프로즌 님이 아발론 안쪽을 돌아보시는 중이고, 저는 이쪽을 보는 중: Yes. Frozen is inspecting the inner part of Avalon, and I'm watching this side. What brings you here, Adventurer?
strings.그러셨구나. 함께 식사하지 못해서 조금 아쉬웠어요. 이리스 님과 이야기는: I see. I was a little disappointed we couldn't share a meal. Did your conversation with Lady Iris go well?
strings.네, 덕분에 잘 끝났어요. 아발론에 다시 오긴 했는데, 여기 진짜 아무것: Yes, it did. I've come back to Avalon, but there's really nothing here, is there?
Even so, we can't know what might happen, so we have to be careful. Oh, Adventurer, there's something I wanted to tell you.
strings.큰일은 아니에요. 메디아 님께서 칼리 전통주 레시피를 주셨는데, 이걸 만: No, nothing serious. Lady Medea gave me a recipe for traditional Kali liquor, but I need your help to make it.
strings.제가 만들 수 있다구요?: You think I can make it?
strings.메디아 님께서 스승님께 선물로 칼리 전통주를 드리려고 하셨는데, 이번 일: Lady Medea wanted to give some to my master as a gift, but she used up so much power during recent events that she can't make it herself.
strings.그래서 제게 레시피를 주셔서 대신 만들면 좋겠다고 하셨는데…. 라피어에: So she gave me the recipe and asked me to make it for her... But it requires a visit to Lapier.
Could you help? I'm sorry. I'm not able to go to Lapier...
strings.라피어…. 괜찮아요. 저도 지스카드 님께 많이 도움을 받았으니까 도와드릴: Lapier... Of course. Lord Ziskad has helped me a great deal, too.
strings.감사해요. 아무래도 모험가님께서 만들어서 스승님께 드리면 유란 언니도 뭐: Thank you. If you make it and give it to him, I don't think Yuran will object.
strings.유란 님은 왜 그렇게 지스카드 님이 술 드시는 걸 싫어해요?: Why does Yuran dislike Lord Ziskad drinking so much?
strings.별 뜻은 없고 건강 조심하시라고 하는 거예요. 스승님, 그렇게 마시다보면: She just wants him to look after his health. She's always saying things like, 'Master, if you keep drinking like that, you may leave this world before Weiss does.'
strings.그래도 요즘은 전처럼 오래 많이 드시진 않으세요. 이번에 발드릭 님하고: Still, he doesn't drink as much or for as long these days. All he's done recently is drink nonstop with Lord Valdrick for about two days.
strings.너무 걱정하지 마세요. 메디아 님도 걱정하셔서 딱 한병 정도 만들 레시피: Don't worry too much. Lady Medea was concerned too, so she gave me a recipe for just one bottle.
strings.다행이다. 재료는 뭔가요?: That's a relief. What ingredients do we need?
strings.고드름 감옥하고 지스크 영지에서 찾으시면 될 거 같아요. 아무래도 특별한: You should find them in Icicle Prison and the Zisk Plains. They're special blueberries, so they have to be gathered in the wild.
I'll prepare the other ingredients. Please bring them back here.
I've brought the blueberries. But all this...
strings.(렌 앞에 커다란 통과 음식 재료로 보이는 주머니들이 잔뜩 놓여 있다.): (A large tub and numerous bags of what appear to be ingredients sit in front of Ren.)
strings.스승님께 드릴 거라 좀 신경을 썼어요. 그건 그렇고 모험가님께서 가져오신: It's for my master, so I wanted to make an effort. That lovely scent must be coming from your blueberries.
It must be. I didn't expect them to smell so strong...
strings.아무것도 남아있지 않은 아발론이라서 더 그런거 같아요. 아, 재료를 제게: Perhaps it's more noticeable because there's nothing left in Avalon. Oh, could you give me the ingredients?
(Ren accepts the blueberries and starts putting them in the large tub, then picks out a single berry.)
I wonder if Tariel is still here. There's nothing left now.
strings.타리엘이요? 얼마 전까지만 해도 우리를 징그럽게 쫓아다니던 거위 정령이잖: Tariel? The goose spirit that kept chasing us so relentlessly until recently?
As you know, %s, spirits dwell in practically everything in the world.
strings.불, 물, 땅, 바람과 같은 원소부터 돌, 꽃, 나무 같은 자연의 일부를: In elements like fire, water, earth, and wind, in natural things like stones, flowers, and trees. Even in the chairs and plates we use at home.
strings.생명을 위해 일하기 때문에 어디든 있어요. 하여튼, 그런 정령이 사람이나: They are everywhere because they work for the sake of life. So if such a spirit harms people or other living beings...
It must have been corrupted by an evil power, or influenced by something stronger than itself.
strings.이제 나쁜 힘도 사라졌으니 여기도 다시 원래대로 돌아가야 해요. 안 그래: Now that the evil power is gone, this place should return to normal too. And you've brought fruit filled with pure energy...
strings.아, 설명이 길었죠? 제가 교단에서 배운 게 있어서 겸사겸사 일을 하려구: Oh, I'm going on too long, aren't I? I want to put something I learned in the order to use while we're here. For Avalon's sake...
strings.(렌이 미리 파둔 땅에 블루베리를 살며시 떨어뜨리고 기도를 올린다. 그리: (Ren gently drops a blueberry into a hole she has dug and offers a prayer. As she prays, a goose's call sounds from somewhere nearby.)
strings.(쌓인 모래 사이에서 거위의 얼굴이 사라졌다 나타나기를 반복하다 모습을: (A goose's head appears and disappears among the drifts of sand before emerging fully. It approaches the hole, picks up the blueberry Ren dropped, and begins shaking it.)
strings.(타리엘이 렌을 향해 인사를 하는 것처럼 계속해서 고개를 끄덕인다. 그러: (Tariel keeps nodding toward Ren as if in greeting, then clutches the blueberry and runs off, vanishing from sight.)
strings.시간이 얼마나 걸릴진 모르겠지만, 타리엘이 제대로 힘을 쓴다면 아발론에도: I don't know how long it will take, but if Tariel uses its power properly, delicious blueberries will grow in Avalon too.
strings.(렌이 가져온 재료를 통에 넣고 커다란 국자로 섞더니 얼마 지나지 않아: (Ren adds the ingredients to the tub and stirs them with a large ladle. Before long, she pours the mixture into a large bottle.)
Take this to the summit of Lapier and shake it for about three minutes, as though you're dancing.
strings.…정말 그러면 되는 걸까요?: ...Is that really all I have to do?
That's what Lady Medea's recipe says. Please trust it and try.
strings.그럴게요. 다 되면 다시 렌에게 가져오면 돼요?: I will. Should I bring it back to you when it's done?
strings.스승님께 바로 가져다 주시면 될거 같아요. 그리고 이건 가다가 배고프시면: You can take it straight to my master. And eat this if you get hungry on the way. It's ciabatta made in the Seres Order's style.
Thank you, Ren. I'll be going.
So the bread has raisins in it.
strings.그런데 칼리 전통주라면서 이렇게 만들어도 되는 걸까? 확실히 좋은 냄새가: But can you really make traditional Kali liquor this way? It certainly smells good...
strings.(시원한 바람을 친구 삼아 오른 라피어의 정상, 지상과는 확실히 다른 깨: (With a cool breeze for company, you reach Lapier's summit. The air feels distinctly purer than it does below.)
strings.확실히 이곳의 공기는 지상과 다르네. 그러고보니 여기서 레퀴엠을 상대했었: The air really is different here. Come to think of it, this is where I fought Requiem...
Has it been that long already?
strings.그러면 다른 거 생각하지 말고 병을 흔들어볼까. 렌의 말대로 춤을 추는: All right, let's stop thinking about other things and shake this bottle. Like dancing, as Ren said...
strings.(사람들은 없지만, 모험가를 쫓아온 라피어의 환수들이 몇 마리 있다.): (No people are nearby, but several of Lapier's mystical beasts have followed the adventurer.)
Sigh. You lot, please pretend you didn't see this. All right, three minutes. Here goes.
It really worked. The color changed! Has it aged? It seems to have...
strings.거기 트락투스, 박수치지 마! 춤도 따라 하지 마!: You there, Tractus! Stop clapping! And don't copy my dance!
strings.제나도 봤으니 돌아가볼까. 아, %s? 여기는 무슨 일인가?: I've seen Jenna. Time to head back. Oh, %s? What brings you here?
strings.며칠 지난 것 뿐이지만, 자넬 다시 보니 기쁘군. 그래, 이리스 님과 이: It's only been a few days, but I'm glad to see you again. Did your conversation with Lady Iris go well?
We will continue doing what we can here for everyone's sake.
strings.아직도 모두를 위협하는 존재들이 남아있어서 가야 할 길은 더욱 험해지겠지: There are still beings that threaten us all. The road ahead will grow more difficult.
And you will continue to face great trials yourself.
strings.괜찮다고 답해주니 고맙네…. 자네는 자네를 믿고, 자네를 믿는 사람들을: Thank you for saying so... I hope you will believe in yourself and act for the people who believe in you.
I'll remember your words, Lord Ziskad.
strings.(%s의 대답에 지스카드가 잠시 생각에 빠진다.): (%s's answer leaves Ziskad briefly lost in thought.)
strings.그런데 자네가 들고 있는 건 뭐지? 통을 보니 칼리에서 들고 온 것 같은: What is that you're carrying, though? From the container, it looks as if it came from Kali...
strings.알지, 알다마다. 이건 칼리 전통주가 아닌가? 오래 전에 칼리에 갈 일이: Of course I do. Traditional Kali liquor, isn't it? They served it to me when I visited Kali long ago.
Did Medea send this? She said what I drank then was the last of it...
strings.(지스카드에게 전통주를 만든 과정을 이야기한다.): (You explain to Ziskad how the liquor was made.)
Medea had it all planned. Giving the recipe to Ren...
strings.아발론에도 새로운 희망의 열매가 피어나길 바라는 마음으로, 렌에게 부탁한: She must have asked Ren in the hope that new fruits of hope would grow in Avalon too.
strings.(칼리 전통주를 받아든 지스카드가 기쁨을 감추지 못한다.): (Ziskad cannot hide his delight as he accepts the traditional Kali liquor.)
I didn't expect you to be so pleased...
That's how precious it is. Rare fruit and long aging give it a deep flavor.
strings.숙성을 시켜야 했는데, 이건 너무 빨리 만든 거 아닐까요?: If it needs aging, didn't we make this much too quickly?
strings.그래서 살짝 편법을 쓴 게 아닐까 싶군. 원래는 마을에서 숙성을 시키던데: I suspect she used a little shortcut. Normally, they age it in the village...
strings.라피어에서 기운을 받아 만들어진 거면 아마도 이리스 님과도 이야기가 됐을: If it was made using Lapier's energy, she probably spoke with Lady Iris about it as well.
strings.향이 좋네. 이런 좋은 걸 나만 마실 수는 없는데… 자네는 어떤가?: A lovely aroma. I can't keep something this good to myself... Will you join me?
I'm fine, thank you. It's a gift for you, Lord Ziskad. You're welcome to enjoy it yourself.
strings.(말이 끝나기가 무섭게 지스카드가 품에서 잔을 꺼내 술을 채운다.): (No sooner has he spoken than Ziskad pulls a cup from inside his clothes and fills it.)
strings.잠깐만요, 왜 잔이 거기서 나와요?: Wait, why did you have a cup in there?
Haha, pretend you didn't see that. Ah, wonderful. I can't be the only one to enjoy something this good. We should share it with everyone.
strings.꼭 술만이 아니더라도, 우리는 칼리 족과 해나갈 일이 많네. 메디아도 같: Not only the liquor. We have much to do together with the Kali tribe. Medea feels the same.
strings.칼리 족을 비롯해 이스트랜드의 여러 세력들이 미래를 위해서 나아가려면 함: The Kali and the other peoples of Eastland must work together if we are to move toward a better future.
I see. That's good to hear.
Very good indeed. Hehe... How long I've waited for this day... Ah...
strings.이런 기분이 대체 얼마만인지…. 오랫동안 느껴보지 못한 기분이네…. 저기: How long has it been since I felt this way...? So very long... Tell me... Are you busy?
strings.별건 아니고, 내 옛날 이야기를 들려주고 싶네. 자네라면 내 이야기를 해: Nothing much. I'd like to tell you about my past. I feel I can share that story with you...
strings.(지스카드가 %s의 반응에 고마워하며 장작은 모아 불을 피운다. 어느 정: (Grateful for %s's response, Ziskad gathers wood and lights a fire. As he finishes, the fragrance of the liquor in his cup stirs memories of the past.)
strings.내가 칼리 마을에 간 게 언제였더라…. 처음 메디아를 만났을 때가 기억나: When was it that I went to Kali Village...? I remember the first time I met Medea.
strings.그래, 하하하. 그때 메디아가 뭐 이런 사람이 다 있냐는 표정으로 날 바: Yes, hahaha. She looked at me as though she'd never met such a person in her life.
(Ziskad's story continues late into the night over the Zisk Plains. With each passing hour, the trust and faith between the two grow deeper.)
